mapper.sql: u.id AS id, s.id AS userSubjectId, s.dept_id AS deptId, s.tenant_id AS tenantId, s.subject_id AS subjectId, (select ru.role_id from sys_role_user ru where ru.user_subject_id = s.id order by ru.id asc limit 1) AS roleId, s.subject_type AS subjectType, (select r.auth from sys_role_user ru inner join sys_role r on r.id = ru.role_id where ru.user_subject_id = s.id order by ru.id asc limit 1) AS roleAuth, u.username AS username, u.password AS password, u.real_name AS realName, u.nickname AS nickName, u.email as email, u.avatar AS avatar, u.status AS status, u.auth_type AS authType, u.auth_secret AS authSecret, u.gender AS gender
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_user AS u INNER JOIN sys_user_subject s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 1 WHERE u.id = #{uId}
SELECT FROM sys_user AS u INNER JOIN sys_user_subject s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 1 WHERE u.username = #{username}
SELECT FROM sys_user AS u INNER JOIN sys_user_subject s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.status = 1 WHERE u.email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM sys_user WHERE email = #{email}
SELECT r.auth FROM sys_role_user ru INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ru.role_id WHERE ru.user_subject_id = #{userSubjectId}
SELECT role_id FROM sys_role_user WHERE user_subject_id = #{userSubjectId} ORDER BY id ASC

select t3.auth_code from sys_role_user t1 left join sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id left join sys_menu t3 on t2.menu_id = t3.id where t1.user_subject_id = #{userSubjectId} and t3.auth_code IS NOT NULL and t3.auth_code != ''
and t3.type in
#{type}
order by t3.sort asc
select t2.dept_id from sys_role_user t1 inner join sys_role_data_scope t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id where t1.user_subject_id = #{userSubjectId}
select id from sys_dept where FIND_IN_SET(#{id}, pids)
select id from sys_dept where position(concat(',', #{id}, ',') in concat(',', pids, ',')) > 0
